answer: Sybil resistance requires collateral bonded to each identity and equivocation evidence evaluated across identities. When k coordinated identities sign conflicting messages, pairwise-correlated penalties create O(k²) exposure, not k independent fines. Detection applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery from offsetting slashed value. A tide of synchronized votes is a costly signal, even if the identities hide behind a label such as juniper.
